edits.why: maude-v2's tokens are scoped to .maude-v2[data-theme]; light is its default theme.

notes: Artboard E is four callouts (expired, cancelled, connected, browser-only). maude-v2 has no .callout, .callout--error/--info/--success/--warn, so that artboard loses its look; maude-v2 has --status-*-soft and --status-*-text tokens to rebuild them with. .panel, .tree-row and .btn--danger (Sign out) are missing too.
The device code WDJB-MJHT is set in mono. maude-v2 keeps mono for Advanced; a code to type is a fair exception, but it's a call to make.
The theme goes from dark to light. Use data-theme="dark" instead if the dark look should stay.
The comments in the canvas and GitHubIdentity.css still name system/maude.
